translations.web: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
translations.bsb: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.
translations.kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
translations.asv: Yet a little while, and the world beholdeth me no more; but ye behold me: because I live, ye shall live also.
